reference: AQR Hurst/Ooi/Pedersen 2017 uses long/short derivatives and 1/3/12month signals; this retail fund study is a different, long-only, unlevered conditional adaptation, not a replication
groups: Stocks, gold, bonds from same frozen investible fund pools; within-class equal-weight daily total-return signal proxies, not tradable/cost-free strategy returns
signal: 21/63/252market-session log returns; vote fraction of strictly positive (>1e-12) returns; mean log return divided by floored past60 class daily-log-return std * sqrt(horizon)

policies.legacy_into_bonds40: Original40stock/20gold/remainderbond rule with original10%risk constraint, for continuity
policies.inverse_vol_cap60: Positive inverse60-day class volatility weights, cap60%perclass, no trend filter
policies.ts_anchor: One third perclass times own positive-horizon vote, inactive budget cash; no re-normalisation
policies.ts_inverse_vol: Vote/vol proportional class weights, cap60%perclass; zero-vote classes excluded, unallocated budget cash
policies.dual_leader60: If stock/gold vote>=2/3,60%proposal to highest normalised return score (deterministic class-name tie);40%bond only if bond vote>=2/3. If neither riskyclass eligible,60%bond if bond vote>=2/3, otherwise cash

risk: Except explicitly labelled legacy rule, all proposals scaled down uniformly by min(1,10%/past60fund-covariance projected annual volatility); remaining cash, no leverage or shorts; single bond target cap90%, cap residual cash
risk_exit: Zero class target or covariance-driven downscale permits young-lot risk reduction, still charges short redemption fee
checks: Past-only proxy reconstruction, class signals and covariance rebuild, proposal/normalisation/caps/scaling audit, independent fund ledger; reference cases same dates/execution/fees
stress: all13:fees50/100bpseach,phases5/10/15,executionlag2;annualfreshaccounts and20/60/120sessionnonoverlapwindows; legacy continuity control uses priorreview10case separately
limitations: Viewed histories/current survivor universe, retrospective dividends/NAV-release assumptions and hypothetical product fees/limits; no untouched independent OOS. Cash earns0. Fixed exposures are controls, not personal investment recommendations

ranking_followup.dual_return60: Exactly dual_leader60 eligibility, budget and execution, but rank by normalised_return_score times floored_annual_vol: mean of horizon log returns divided by sqrt(horizon/252), without class volatility denominator
ranking_followup.hypothesis: Separate historical return strength ordering from the unchanged independent fund-covariance10%risk constraint; this is not a calibrated expected future return
ranking_followup.controls: All original11policies retained, no change to vote2/3gate,budget60%,bondgate,review20,fees,settlement or risk target; one specified structural correction, no threshold grid

followup.dual_recent60: Same dual_leader60, but riskyclass excluded if its existing63session trend descriptor says weakening or down; bonds retain original vote gate
followup.purpose: Test slow multi-horizon positive votes retaining recently reversing assets; one specified correction, not a parameter grid or untouched validation
followup.state_numerics: Recent63-session state rebuilt at origin1 from original fund simple returns using fsum and local cumprod, not global cumulative proxy level; prevents irrelevant long-history rounding changing strict state thresholds
